name: The Kobold King (Dread Wight Kobold Fighter 2/Sorcerer 4) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on The Kobold King (Dread Wight Kobold Fighter 2/Sorcerer 4) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Kobold King (Kobold Fighter 2/Sorcerer 4)" but are not part of the The Kobold King (Dread Wight Kobold Fighter 2/Sorcerer 4) entry, which is unchanged.

hp 43 (2d10+4d6+12)
Fort +6, Ref +3, Will +7; +8 vs. fear
Resist fire 5
Weakness light sensitivity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 human bane battleaxe +9 (1d8+14/x3)(against humans: +11, 1d8+16 plus 2d6/x3)

0 – daze (DC 12), detect magic, detect poison, light

TACTICS

Before Combat The kobold king casts bull’s strength, mage armor and enlarge person on himself.
During Combat The kobold king casts sleep first, then magic missiles long as his minions tie up PCs. He wields his human bane battleaxe two handed in melee and uses Power Attack (already figured in). He targets humans with his axe whenever possible.
Morale The kobold king fights to the death.

Ref +4
Melee +1 human bane battleaxe +7 (1d8+10/x3)(against humans: +9, 1d8+12 plus 2d6/x3)
Special Attacks grow claws (2 claws +7 (1d3+2), lasts 5 rounds)
Str 15, Dex 16
CMB +5; CMD 17
Skills Acrobatics +7, Climb +6, Stealth +11
